heading: Maintaining necessary capability with respect to acquisition of architectural and engineering services
lead: The Administrator, in consultation with the Secretary of Defense, the Administrator of General Services, and the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, shall develop and implement a plan to ensure that the Federal Government maintains the necessary capability with respect to the acquisition of architectural and engineering services to—

tree.text: ensure that Federal Government employees have the expertise to determine agency requirements for those services;
establish priorities and programs, including acquisition plans;
award and administer contracts for those services.
